```{r echo = FALSE}
require(remotes)
remotes::install_github("rowlandseymour/speedyBBT")
```

## Introduction 

+ Web application allows judges to input comparative judgment data
+ R package for data analysis and parameter estimation
+ Making the package more user-friendly and adherent with R package practices

## speedyBBT

+ Several forms of Bayesian Bradley-Terry model 
+ `speedyBBTm` uses Poly&a-Gamma latent variables to improve speed
+ `BBTm.ties` allows for ties
+ `BBTm` allows for comparison-specific and player-specific advantages 

## Requested improvements

+ Use R objects to make model output use standard functions
+ Improve test coverage
+ Improve documentation
+ Make `pkgdown` site

## Data objects


```{r}
library(speedyBBT)
head("forcedMarriage")

```
